t: You're in Golden Square, a mainly hard-surfaced garden square in Soho, with a few mature trees and raised borders, surrounded by classical office buildings. Many media, advertising and public relations companies are based around it, and the square has appeared in many works of literature. Charles Craufurd, a Scottish soldier, was born here in 1763. He became a British lieutenant-general and was knighted with the Grand Cross of the Bath. He died in 1821.
